Six selected scyphozoan stages are arranged in clockwise order: adult medusa, planula, settled polyp, strobila, eight-lobed ephyra and juvenile medusa. All six introduced transitions remain; the left upward arrow connects the juvenile and adult stages. Three representative medusa tentacles and three polyp tentacles are cues, not biological counts. Strobila retains three bands; ephyra retains eight lobes. Sizes and positions are independently reorganised; no constant biological scale, literal offspring count or universal jellyfish lifecycle is claimed.
